aboutTitle: Stay Together. Stay Comfortable. Stay Private.
aboutBody:
**Joy AC Hall & Rooms** offers affordable accommodation in Thangachimadam, Rameswaram for families, friends and groups travelling together.

Choose from private rooms suitable for **4–10 guests** or our dedicated **Group Private Stay for approximately 50–60 guests**.

With guest kitchen facilities, fresh-up facilities, Wi-Fi, RO drinking water, covered parking and 24/7 CCTV, our property is designed for travellers who value space, convenience and the comfort of staying together.
heroSubtitle: Comfortable private stays for families and groups of 4–60 guests in Thangachimadam, conveniently located for exploring Rameswaram, Pamban Bridge and the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial.
